name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_reset_selected_browse_record
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::ResetSelectedBrowseRecordAndRefreshList clears a cached browse record, resets the session list UI, disables query controls, and requests the active WOL list mode.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43e3b0 validates the cached browse-record session-name byte at offset 0x34, conditional WOL API ResetQueryState vtable slot 0x24, 0x10c-byte cached-record clear, LB_RESETCONTENT sent to m_sessionResultsList, clearing g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeCreateSessionFromQueryFlag, disabling query/connect/query-mode buttons, and RequestListMode(activeListMode, 1) through API vtable slot 0x18.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_reset_selected_browse_record_smoke patches SendMessageA and CWnd::EnableWindow, drives a fake WOL API vtable, and verifies cached-record clearing, list reset, disabled-control order, create-session flag clearing, ResetQueryState, and RequestListMode arguments.
